steps: Preheat the oven to 190 °C (375 °F) and line a baking sheet with parchment.
Peel and cube Sweet potato, then steam for 12 minutes until completely tender.
Mash the cooked Sweet potato in a large bowl until smooth.
Add the Egg and Canola oil to the bowl and stir well.
Stir in the Rolled oats and Cinnamon until a thick dough forms.
Scoop tablespoon-sized portions and roll into balls.
Arrange balls on the prepared sheet, spacing 3 cm apart.
Bake for 15 to 18 minutes, until golden and firm to the touch.
Cool completely on the sheet before serving. Keep refrigerated up to 3 days or freeze up to 1 month.
